mentions.name: Ballad
mentions.description: An inbound marketing engine that runs itself: it plans what the user should write, drafts content in their voice, publishes to their accounts, and handles attribution so results feed into future content planning.
mentions.problem: Founders without a marketing person struggle to scale inbound marketing; the author's previous company (Courier, YC S19) had great inbound but could never scale it.
mentions.audience: Founders who don't have a marketing person and aren't going to hire one.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building Ballad – an inbound marketing engine that runs itself. I'm building it for other founders like myself who don't have a marketing person and aren't going to hire one.

evidence.value: I've been building Ballad – an inbound marketing engine that runs itself. I'm building it for other founders like myself who don't have a marketing person and aren't going to hire one.
